components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width transfer CTA using theme --btn tokens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: #29233b; color: #fff; font: 700 16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2775ca; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid #dbdeec; background: #fff; color: #29233b; font: 600 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2a4f8a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bridge Card
components.css: .ds-bridge-card { width: min(540px, 100%); background: #eeeff7; border: 1px solid #dbdeec; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 28px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(41, 35, 59, 0.06), 0 12px 32px rgba(41, 35, 59, 0.05); color: #29233b; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bridge-card h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-bridge-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #664e4d; }

components.name: Field Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 600 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #29233b; } .ds-field input { height: 48px; border: 1px solid #dbdeec; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: #fff; padding: 0 16px; font: 13px ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace; color: #29233b; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #c8ccd9; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2a4f8a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Info Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 10px; background: #dce6f8; color: #2a4f8a; font: 600 12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview: Relay’s UI is a task-first bridge console: a single high-radius card centered on cool paper, with system sans type, monospaced addresses, and chain marks. Light mode is lavender-tinted paper and violet ink; dark mode is near-black with a warm amber accent for primary actions and borders. Expression lives in density, status clarity, and honest mainnet warnings—not in marketing illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Dual theme: cool paper + violet (light) / near-black + amber (dark)
High-radius surfaces replaced with two-tier compact radii (12px cards, 10px controls)
Centered operate layout with history and FAQ below
System UI font stack; mono for addresses

rules.name: The Token Surface Rule
rules.body: Prefer semantic vars over raw hex in components so light/dark stay coherent.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Light uses violet/blue action accent; dark uses amber for primary CTA. Do not add a third accent family without tokens.

rules.name: The System Stack Rule
rules.body: Stay on platform fonts; do not add marketing webfonts without intent.

rules.name: The Single Card Rule
rules.body: Transfer task lives in one elevated card; supporting tools sit below.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: No multi-layer glass stacks; elevation reserved for card and modal sheet.

dos: Do use CSS variables for any new control so both themes inherit.
Do keep the bridge card as the single primary focus above the fold on desktop.
Do show mainnet risk, fee breakdown, and progress persistence messaging near high-stakes actions.
Do pair chain icons with text labels; never rely on color alone for chain identity.
donts: Don't introduce indigo–violet marketing gradients or glassmorphism stacks.
Don't hard-code light-only hex in new components.
Don't add interface fee claims or official Circle branding not in product truth.
Don't remove resume/progress affordances for visual minimalism.
